text.tspan: How your nerves send messages to your brain
The petals are like the tiny branching
nerve endings in your skin, muscles
Stretch, pressure and movement tell your
brain where your feet are, so you can
Pressure or force, like stubbing your toe
Temperature, like hot sand or icy water
The stem is like your nerve, carrying messages to your spinal cord.
A dull ache or burn that follows
is one way it protects you.
When your sunflower becomes extra sensitive
The petals open wide and the volume turns up,
so everyday pressure or touch can feel sore.
More pain doesn't always mean more damage.
The petals send messages. Your brain decides what hurts.
